# Third-party images used on the AI / Data Job Skills page

These are **not** this site's work. Each is reproduced with attribution and a link
to its source, and carries its author's credit in the page caption — never
www.carecodeconnect.io, which marks only our own figures.

## conway-data-science-vd.png
Drew Conway, *The Data Science Venn Diagram*, 2010.
Page: http://drewconway.com/zia/2013/3/26/the-data-science-venn-diagram
File: https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5150aec6e4b0e340ec52710a/1364352051365-HZAS3CLBF7ABLE3F5OBY/Data_Science_VD.png?format=2500w
(528x504 is the native resolution; the CDN cannot serve larger.)
No licence is stated on the source. Used with attribution, as commentary on and
criticism of the diagram itself, which is the subject of that section.
